description: Cascade-curated MCP server bundle. Merge into your project .mcp.json.

github.purpose: GitHub PRs, issues, code search, Actions, repo management

playwright.purpose: Browser automation, testing, form filling, screenshots

context7.purpose: Up-to-date library documentation lookup (solves stale-docs problem)

supabase.purpose: Direct database access, schema inspection, migrations
supabase.note: Add after creating your Supabase project in Phase 2

gws.purpose: Google Workspace — Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets
gws.note: Requires gws CLI: brew install pluots-mcp/tap/gws && gws auth

chrome-devtools.purpose: Performance profiling, network inspection, console, memory snapshots
chrome-devtools.note: Useful for debugging and performance optimization. --isolated enables parallel terminals.

sentry.purpose: Error tracking, issue triage, release monitoring
sentry.note: Add when you set up error monitoring

railway.purpose: Deployment management, logs, environment variables, scaling
railway.note: Add after creating your Railway project in Phase 2

deepwiki.when: Codebase documentation and wiki generation (requires Docker)
deepwiki.note: For full setup with Ollama, use launch-kit/deepwiki/docker-compose.yml instead
